onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to XPRS
onboarding.welcome.intro: Create a profile to sign the wapps you build and install. You can generate a fresh Nostr identity or import an existing nsec.
onboarding.welcome.custom_desc: Want your initials in it? Search for a callsign that contains letters you like.
onboarding.welcome.storage_note: Your profile lives at ~/.local/share/xprs/devices/<id>/. Back it up by copying the folder. Your nsec is stored inside profiles.json — keep it secret.
onboarding.restore.title: Restore your previous identity
onboarding.restore.found: A backup from a previous install was found on this phone.
onboarding.restore.need_storage: Storage access is needed to read the backup on this phone.
onboarding.restore.none: No backup found on this device.
onboarding.import.title: Import existing profile
onboarding.import.intro: Paste a Nostr private key (nsec1…) below. The matching callsign and npub will be derived automatically.
onboarding.backup.title: Protect your identity
onboarding.backup.intro: Allow storage access so XPRS can keep a backup of your secret key on this phone. It lets you restore this identity if you reinstall the app or clear its data.
onboarding.backup.passphrase_warning: The backup is encrypted with this passphrase. If you forget it, the backup cannot be restored.
onboarding.unlock.keep_desc: Lets messages arrive in the background and skips this screen. The key is stored on this device.
onboarding.vanity.title: Custom callsign
onboarding.vanity.intro: Type a few letters you want in your callsign — your initials, a word, anything. Random identities are generated until one contains them.
onboarding.vanity.rarity: Every extra character makes it far rarer: 1–2 letters land in seconds, 4 can take many minutes.
onboarding.vanity.alphabet: Callsigns cannot contain B, I, O or 1 — those characters do not exist in the alphabet a callsign is built from, so they are not accepted here.
onboarding.vanity.length_risk: About {users} users before two people share one, and someone can grind a key that wears yours {effort}. A callsign is a label, not proof of who you are — messages are signed with your key either way.
onboarding.vanity.empty:
Matches will appear here.
Your callsign stays {callsign} until you pick one.
onboarding.apps.on_home: You will find {name} on your home screen.
onboarding.apps.status.title: Status
onboarding.apps.status.lead: Say what you are up to, to everyone around you.
onboarding.apps.status.point1: Write a short status and it goes out on every radio this device has, no internet needed.
onboarding.apps.status.point2: Read the statuses of the people nearby, and follow the ones you want to hear from first.
onboarding.apps.status.point3: The people you chat with show their newest status at the top of Chat.
onboarding.apps.chat.title: Chat
onboarding.apps.chat.lead: Talk to the people around you, in groups or one to one.
onboarding.apps.chat.point1: Local chat is everyone within radio range. It is always there.
onboarding.apps.chat.point2: Start a private chat with a station by its callsign. It is sealed once both keys are known.
onboarding.apps.chat.point3: Groups are named rooms. Closed groups are for their members only.
onboarding.apps.mesh.title: Mesh
onboarding.apps.mesh.lead: See who is within reach, and how.
onboarding.apps.mesh.point1: A live map of the stations and devices this one can hear.
onboarding.apps.mesh.point2: Shows whether someone is reached over Bluetooth, the local network or the internet.
onboarding.apps.mesh.point3: Manage the hubs your station connects through.
